YT Premium patch is experimental on safari and cannot be directly injected or activated permenatly.

For users:
   - Go to https://youtube.com/ (not m.youtube.com and don’t let safari open the youtube app
   - Click share icon on safari page and scroll to the bottom until you find “Activate YT Premium Patch” and click it and wait until you see “YT Premium patch activated”.
   - YT Premium patch cannot be activated forever due to apple’s restrictions and will be deactivated automatically after refreshing page.
